item.title: LaCour To Head Blackbaud Giving Fund
item.description: Catherine LaCour was appointed CEO and executive director of The Blackbaud Giving FundⓇ effective immediately. The Fund has disbursed $2.75 billion from donors to more than 286,000 nonprofits worldwide since its inception in 2020. LaCour will lead the Fund’s strategy, oversee governance and regulatory compliance, and steward its partnerships with Blackbaud and other social impact partners.
